question: Should OpenClaw add agent-scoped web/tool credential configuration, and if so should it be a generic plugin/tool config contract or a narrow `agents.list[].tools.web` override?
rationale: The requested behavior changes credential scoping, config precedence, and provider selection across agents; source evidence shows the gap, but the safe permanent boundary is a maintainer product/security decision.

options.title: Design Generic Agent-Scoped Credential Config
options.body: Add a single SecretRef-aware per-agent plugin/tool config contract that web search can consume, and use this issue plus the related plugin-config issue as design inputs.

options.title: Add Narrow Web-Search Override
options.body: Allow only `agents.list[].tools.web.search` overrides, which is smaller but risks a parallel config path beside plugin-scoped webSearch credentials.

options.title: Keep Gateway-Wide Tool Credentials
options.body: Decline per-agent web/tool credentials and document separate gateway instances or explicit cron payload overrides as the supported isolation boundary.

recommendation.title: Design Generic Agent-Scoped Credential Config
recommendation.body: Add a single SecretRef-aware per-agent plugin/tool config contract that web search can consume, and use this issue plus the related plugin-config issue as design inputs.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available local history signal for the config/schema boundary and the likely product/security routing point is the recent central config touch by steipete.
